from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyCashFlow(BaseModel):
    """One company's 'Cash paid for goods and services' amount for the period in question."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company name as reported in the document")
    metric_name: str | None = Field(description="The line-item name, e.g. '购买商品、接受劳务支付的现金'")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The numeric amount reported for the period")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="The currency unit, e.g. '元'")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period, e.g. '2024年第一季度'")
    quote: str = Field(description="Short excerpt from the document containing the amount")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_cash_flows: list[CompanyCashFlow]
